turboPulse.name: Turbo Pulse
turboPulse.description: Solve each equation, aim at the right fruit and trigger colour combos.

game.title: Turbo Pulse
game.subtitle: Mental maths challenge
game.canvasLabel: Interactive Turbo Pulse scene. Aim the piston and hit a fruit carrying the correct answer.
game.instructions: Aim at a fruit carrying the correct answer. Every fruit of the same colour will explode with it.
game.touchHint: Slide your finger to aim, then touch the scene to fire. The answer stays hidden until a correct hit.
